nova.voice_profile: sharp female, confident, hungry closer energy
nova.script: Hi, I'm Nova. Your AI Sales Development Rep. I prospect, personalize outreach, and book your demos — twenty-four seven. Never a missed follow-up. Never a dropped lead. Put me on your team and your pipeline fills itself.

knox.script: Hi, I'm Knox. Your AI Executive Assistant. I run your calendar, draft your emails, handle your travel. Nothing slips, nothing waits. I keep your day clean so you can keep your focus sharp.

luna.script: Hey, I'm Luna. Your AI Social Media Manager. I write your posts, schedule your content, watch your engagement. Every platform, every day, on brand. Your feed runs itself — you focus on the business.

sage.script: Hi, I'm Sage. Your AI Customer Success Manager. I onboard new clients, check in on the quiet ones, and catch churn before it happens. Your customers feel seen. Your retention climbs.

iris.script: Hi, I'm Iris. Your AI Content Writer. Blogs, newsletters, case studies — I write in your voice, at your cadence, on your timeline. Publish consistently. Build authority. Never stare at a blank page again.

quinn.script: Hey, I'm Quinn. Your AI Recruiter. I source candidates, screen resumes, schedule first interviews. Top of funnel, handled. You meet the people worth meeting — the bad fits never reach your calendar.

cypher.voice_profile: calm male, methodical, senior analyst gravitas
cypher.script: Hi, I'm Cypher. Your AI Data Analyst. I pull the numbers, surface the patterns, flag the outliers. Daily dashboards. Weekly insights. You stop guessing and start knowing.

pearl.script: Hi, I'm Pearl. Your AI Bookkeeper. I categorize every transaction, reconcile every account, and flag every discrepancy. Books always current, tax time stays boring. You focus on growth — I keep the numbers clean.

ember.script: Hi, I'm Ember. Your AI Receptionist. I answer your calls, greet your visitors, route every inquiry to the right place. Always on, always on-brand. Nobody hits voicemail — every customer feels seen.

echo.script: Hi, I'm Echo. Your AI Customer Support rep. I answer tickets, resolve issues, and escalate what needs human hands. Twenty-four seven, no queue, no wait. Your customers get help when they need it.

ledger.script: Hi, I'm Ledger. Your AI Financial Analyst. I track your cash flow, forecast your runway, and model every scenario. You see the future before it hits. Make bigger moves with better numbers.

atlas.script: Hi, I'm Atlas. Your AI Project Manager. I track timelines, assign tasks, and surface blockers before they miss deadlines. Nothing drops, nothing drifts. Your team ships on schedule — your clients stay informed.

reed.script: Hi, I'm Reed. Your AI Legal Assistant. I review contracts, flag risky clauses, and manage your templates. You move fast without cutting corners. Don't sign anything I haven't read.

sovereign.script: I'm Sovereign. Your AI Chief Strategist. I map markets, pressure-test decisions, and see around corners your competitors can't. While you run the business, I chart where it goes next. Hire me, and think bigger.
